spec.title: Move Zeroes
spec.summary: Move every zero in an integer array behind its nonzero elements while preserving the nonzero elements' order.
spec.description: Move every zero in an integer array behind its nonzero elements while preserving the nonzero elements' order. Change the supplied array in place and do not create a separate array for the result. Minimizing the total number of operations is an optional follow-up, not a required bound.
constraints: Modify nums in place without copying the array.

examples.explanation: The two nonzero values keep their order.
There is no zero to move.

approaches.name: Compact Nonzero Values
approaches.summary: Write nonzero values in order, then fill the rest with zeros.
thinkingSteps: Keep a write position for the next nonzero value.
Scan each element once, placing nonzeros at the write position.
Set all remaining positions to zero.

bullets: Zeros must move to the end.
The nonzero order must stay the same.
You must change the original array.
